verdict.rationale: Gitea is explicitly designed to be self-hosted as the core product itself: it's a single binary that deploys easily across OSes/architectures (Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD, Kubernetes; x86/arm64), supports multiple databases, and offers single-server or replicated deployment options. Extensive community evidence corroborates real-world self-hosting for teams of various sizes with simple binary upgrades and lower resource usage than alternatives. Missing for 10: no direct evidence of official managed/hosted-cloud alternative comparison or large-scale (1000+ user) self-hosting case studies confirming it scales fully in production.
